## Experience

- MGLogics (Dec 2021 to Jun 2026, remote): full-stack Ruby on Rails and React engineer on Shopify and BigCommerce apps, catalog and order sync, and Amazon SP-API integrations.

## Projects

- [shop_mcp_server](https://github.com/mjesar/shop_mcp_server): MCP server in Rails exposing a store's products, orders and inventory to Claude, with pgvector semantic search.
- [ai_shop_assistant](https://github.com/mjesar/ai_shop_assistant): shopping assistant using RubyLLM, Gemini and Shopify's Catalog API over MCP.
- [product_geo_agent](https://github.com/mjesar/product_geo_agent): agent that scores how discoverable a Shopify product is to AI assistants (GEO and AEO).
- [support_engineer](https://github.com/mjesar/support_engineer): Rails 8 AI support agent with human approval before actions.
